title: 3.1.7e Lab — radians() Helper
description: Use the radians() helper to set a fixed 45-degree rotation on the Y axis.

steps.title: Create a Cube
steps.instructions: In setup(), write `cube = new Cube(0, 0, 0)` to place a cube at the origin.
hints: Give the cube a color so the rotation angle is easy to see.

steps.title: Set a 45-degree Y rotation using radians()
steps.instructions: Set `cube.rotation.y = radians(45)` to tilt the cube 45 degrees on the Y axis.
hints: radians(45) returns PI/4 ≈ 0.785. You could write 0.785 directly, but radians(45) is much clearer.

requirements.title: radians() helper is called
requirements.description: The radians() function is used somewhere in the sketch.

requirements.title: rotation.y is assigned
requirements.description: cube.rotation.y is set to a value.
